skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Fly Into the Street
skins.content: Monster Hunter Collaborative Series/Fly Into the Street. The Felynes are amped with excitement for getting some Terra-style fresh fits on, and spray paint-filled cans especially pique their curiosity. Noir Corne senses something big and bad's about to go down.
skins.usage: Attire gifted to the Felynes after arriving on Rhodes Island.
skins.quote: 'Just a quick spray here, here, aaand here. Purrfect! Yes, my graffiti's quite remeowkable, if I say so myself! Quick, snap a picture of us together!'
